findings.description: The Lambda environment contains an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. Environment variables are accessible to Lambda code and may be exposed through configuration access, logs, or deployment artifacts, allowing unauthorized use of the associated IAM principal.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime. Unsupported runtimes no longer receive security updates, increasing exposure to known vulnerabilities in the runtime environment.
